perks.name: Accretion
perks.description: Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.
perks.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Grants stacks of Accretion, up to a maximum of 20 stacks. Stacks persist until death.
Special Ammo Bricks grant 1 stack of Accretion. Heavy Ammo Bricks grant 3 stacks of Accretion.

Accretion:
Grants a Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier per stack, up to a maximum of 0.8x Ready/Stow Animation Duration at 20 stacks.

perks.name: Doppler Effect
perks.description: Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
perks.exact:
Solar Buffs applied to the user and Strand Debuffs inflicted to enemies last 50% longer.
Equipping Ember of Solace or Thread of Continuity results in the effects lasting 70% longer.

item.name: Harmonic Siphon
item.description: Rapid Arc weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.
